(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (norm cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<?))
    (define (rot cells) (norm (rotate-cells-cw cells)))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (objects g 0)])
      (let loop ((k 0) (shape (norm (obj-cells obj))) (acc out))
        (if (= k 4)
            acc
            (loop (+ k 1)
                  (rot shape)
                  (paint-cells acc
                               (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (obj-r1 obj) (first p)) (+ (obj-c1 obj) (second p)))) shape)
                               (obj-color obj))))))))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (norm cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<?))
    (define (rot cells) (norm (rotate-cells-cw cells)))
    (define (rotational-closure obj)
      (let* ((s0 (norm (obj-cells obj)))
             (s1 (rot s0))
             (s2 (rot s1))
             (s3 (rot s2)))
        (remove-duplicates (append s0 s1 s2 s3) equal?)))
    (define (mirror-h cells side)
      (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- side 1 (second p)))) cells))
    (let* ((infos
            (map (lambda (obj)
                   (let ((closed (rotational-closure obj)))
                     (list obj closed (length closed))))
                 (objects g 0)))
           (winner
            (foldl (lambda (info best)
                     (if (> (third info) (third best)) info best))
                   (first infos)
                   (rest infos))))
      (for/fold ([out g]) ([info infos])
        (let* ((obj (first info))
               (rotational (second info))
               (completed
                (if (equal? info winner)
                    (append rotational (mirror-h rotational (obj-w obj)))
                    rotational)))
          (paint-cells out
                       (map (lambda (p)
                              (list (+ (obj-r1 obj) (first p))
                                    (+ (obj-c1 obj) (second p))))
                            completed)
                       (obj-color obj)))))))
